title: edbrowse through 3.8.19 contains an integer overflow in stringAndBytes() that allows malicious servers to write past a…
description: edbrowse versions through 3.8.19 have an integer overflow vulnerability in the stringAndBytes() function. This flaw allows malicious servers to send response bodies larger than 2 GB, causing a heap buffer overflow. When a user visits an attacker-controlled HTTP, FTP, or gopher server, the overflow can corrupt the heap, leading to crashes or potentially remote code execution.
